acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent acquisition mode, with MS spectra scanning from m/z 350–1550 at 120000 resolution with AGC target of 4e5.

cleavage_agent.evidence: 20 μg of protein from each sample was lysed, denatured, and digested into peptides with Trypsin and LysC using the PreOmics iST-NHS kit (PreOmics GmbH) with minor modifications as described below.
20 μg of protein from each sample was lysed, denatured, and digested into peptides with Trypsin and LysC using the PreOmics iST-NHS kit (PreOmics GmbH) with minor modifications as described below.

collision_energy.evidence: peptide ions with charge states ≥2–5 were isolated with an isolation window of 0.7 m/z, and fragmented with high energy collision (HCD) mode with stepped collision energy of 35 ± 5%.

fractionation_method.evidence: 100 μg of pooled peptides were fractioned by offline high-pH fractionation using the Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) as per the manufacturer's instructions, with additional fractions containing 14%, 16%, 19% and 21% (v/v) ACN, to a total of 12 fractions.

fragmentation_method.evidence: peptide ions with charge states ≥2–5 were isolated with an isolation window of 0.7 m/z, and fragmented with high energy collision (HCD) mode with stepped collision energy of 35 ± 5%.

instrument.evidence: Liquid chromatography (LC) coupled MS/MS was carried out on an Orbitrap Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) with a nanoESI interface in conjunction with an Ultimate 3000 RSLC nanoHPLC (Dionex Ultimate 3000).

labeling.evidence: Alkylated peptides from individual samples were individually labelled with TMT6plex Tandem Mass Tags (TMT; Thermo Fisher) at a ratio of 8 μg tag to 1 μg protein.
